question: If the volume of a cube is 81sqrt 3 c{m³}, then its total surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cube = a³ = 81√3 cm³

⇒ a³ = 3⁴ × 3¹/² = 3⁴.⁵ = (3¹.⁵)³

⇒ Side **a = 3√3 cm**

Total Surface Area = 6a² = 6 × (3√3)² = 6 × 27 = 162 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 162 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Volume of cube = 81√3 cm³

**Formula Used:** Volume of cube = a³ | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 6a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ad9c39d25f8a8b46411fe531449782d91f8175b277453603b2550bfc21124a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 81√3

⇒ a³ = 27 × 3 × √3

⇒ a³ = 3³ × (√3)² × √3

⇒ a³ = 3³ × (√3)³

⇒ a = 3 × √3

⇒ a = 3√3 cm

⇒ Total Surface Area = 6 × (3√3)²

⇒ TSA = 6 × (9 × 3)

⇒ TSA = 6 × 27

⇒ TSA = 162 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 162 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube Mensuration Formulas

Lateral Surface Area = 4a², Diagonal of a cube = a√3, and Volume = a³ where a is the side length.

Total Surface Area Concept

The total surface area is the sum of the areas of all 6 square faces of the cube, which is 6 × side².</p
